about: Swift packages the app builds from a Spoken-Margins copy, keyed by Package.resolved identity. scripts/package_watch.py checks each copy's upstream weekly. A package not listed here is its own upstream.

onnxruntime-swift-package-manager.why: Upstream returned 404 on 2026-11-17 (#4512); the copy is unmodified, pushed from a SwiftPM cache (#4568).
